params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in response. Anonymous callers may only use `view` and `embed`.

params.name: page
params.description: Current page of the collection.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in result set. Values outside 1-100 return a 400 rest_invalid_param.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: after
params.description: Limit response to posts published after a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: before
params.description: Limit response to posts published before a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: modified_after
params.description: Limit response to posts modified after a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: modified_before
params.description: Limit response to posts modified before a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the result set by a specific number of items.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit result set to posts with one or more specific slugs.

params.name: status
params.description: Limit result set to posts assigned one or more statuses. Anonymous callers may only request `publish`.

params.name: search_columns
params.description: Array of column names to be searched.

params.name: search_semantics
params.description: How to interpret the search input.

params.name: author
params.description: Limit result set to items assigned to specific authors.

params.name: author_exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes items assigned to specific authors.

params.name: menu_order
params.description: Limit result set to items with a specific menu_order value.

params.name: orderby
params.description: Sort collection by object attribute.

params.name: portfolio-types
params.description: Limit result set to items with specific portfolio-types terms.

params.name: portfolio-types_exclude
params.description: Limit result set to items except those with specific portfolio-types terms.

params.name: tax_relation
params.description: Limit result set based on relationship between multiple taxonomies.

items.docs: Lists published items of the `portfolio` custom post type registered by the site theme. This deployment returns an empty array (X-WP-Total 0); the leadership content is authored inside the About Us page.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier for the object.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in response. Anonymous callers may only use `view` and `embed`.

params.name: password
params.description: The password for the item if it is password protected.
